name: Iron Caldera
look: a heavy robot Entei of banded brown armour with glowing vents, a grey skull mask under crimson and gold crests, a fan of grey blades, a mane of glowing flame under black smoke and orange laser beams
entry: A Pokémon resembling Entei, described in an expedition log about a volcano that walked away from its crater. Lava pools wherever it stands, and the beams that lance from its mane can melt rock.
how: Wild: very rare at night in volcanic biomes, deserts and badlands.
